title: INVESTIGATING ANNOTATOR BIAS IN LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS FOR HATE SPEECH DETECTION
findings: The study found evidence of religious bias in LLM-based annotation. For example, a 'Muslim' annotator persona was more likely to flag content critical of religion as hateful compared to a 'Not Muslim' persona. The mismatch in annotations between these two personas was significant across all tested models (GPT-3.5, GPT-4o, Llama-3.1, Gemma-2) on both the custom HateBiasNet and the existing ETHOS datasets. For instance, on the HateBiasNet dataset, the mismatch ranged from 8.02% (GPT-3.5) to 10.56% (Gemma-2).
